critique_history.assessment:
- Long vertical strands float behind and through the plant; remove the detached petiole ridges.
- Fine parallel venation is effectively absent in most views; place visible veins directly across the upper blade.
- The blade becomes extremely narrow edge-on and its petiole junction is abrupt; add stronger width/camber and a continuous tapered attachment.
The model clearly presents a single elongated banana leaf with dense parallel venation, a prominent midrib, and an attached slender petiole.
